g.text: Title: Service source, bit-line bank and polarity routing

g.desc: Title: Service source, bit-line bank and polarity routing

g.text: All ADG54xx use P15/N15. Respect powered-rail sequencing.

g.desc: All ADG54xx use P15/N15. Respect powered-rail sequencing.

g.text: Only the held service address is used.

g.desc: Only the held service address is used.

g.text: A clears the PI output-to-sum path.

g.desc: A clears the PI output-to-sum path.

g.text: D discharges the feedback capacitor directly.

g.desc: D discharges the feedback capacitor directly.

g.text: U1601 no longer supplies DUT power.

g.desc: U1601 no longer supplies DUT power.

g.text: 1600 / SERVICE COMMAND, ROUTING AND CONTROLLER RESET

g.desc: 1600 / SERVICE COMMAND, ROUTING AND CONTROLLER RESET

g.text: OFF selects zero; ON selects regulator error.

g.desc: OFF selects zero; ON selects regulator error.

g.text: The PI controller and shunts are on sheet 2100.

g.desc: The PI controller and shunts are on sheet 2100.

g.text: R1600/R1601 must remain DNP for microamp operation. Power OFF discharges SOURCE through the selected shunt.

g.desc: R1600/R1601 must remain DNP for microamp operation. Power OFF discharges SOURCE through the selected shunt.

g.text: Before range, polarity or route changes: source OFF, discharge and wait; a loaded/open high-R range takes longer.

g.desc: Before range, polarity or route changes: source OFF, discharge and wait; a loaded/open high-R range takes longer.

g.text: WRITE: direct GND; old low-side sink removed.

g.desc: WRITE: direct GND; old low-side sink removed.

g.text: OFF: shunt input to GND. ON: CV/CC driver.

g.desc: OFF: shunt input to GND. ON: CV/CC driver.

g.text: No pulse switch after the current shunt.

g.desc: No pulse switch after the current shunt.
